title: Transit Gateway
explanation: AWS Transit Gateway is a network transit hub that connects VPCs and on-premises networks through a central hub. It simplifies network architecture by eliminating complex peering relationships.
analogy: A Transit Gateway is like a central airport hub — instead of direct flights between every city pair, all routes go through the hub, simplifying connections dramatically.
keyPoints: Acts as a regional hub connecting multiple VPCs and on-premises networks
Supports transitive routing — unlike VPC peering
Can peer with Transit Gateways in other Regions (inter-Region peering)
Supports route tables for fine-grained routing control

examKeywords.definition: A regional network transit hub that connects multiple VPCs and on-premises networks through a central point, supporting transitive routing.

commonMistakes: Using VPC peering for many-to-many connectivity instead of Transit Gateway
Not understanding that Transit Gateway is Region-scoped — use inter-Region peering for cross-Region
